name: Computers, laptops and IT hardware shops

problems.words: Quote dete hain, client baad mein confirm karta hai aur rate barh chuka hota hai
quick_ideas: Put a validity date on every quote from today, so an old rate can't be held against you
Note which items move most in price, so those are quoted with extra care.

workzap_build.text: a quotation builder with validity date, price-change flag and quote-to-order tracking.

problems.free_stops: How quotes are built and flagged is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare this week's sent quotes with today's supplier rates for the same items, so sudden margin loss on delayed confirmations shows.
Give one person the quote register and one daily review time, so changed rates are caught before client confirmations arrive.

problems.words: Pata nahi kaun se quote order bane
quick_ideas: List last month's quotes and mark which became orders, so you know your real conversion
Follow up the open ones, because many quotes go quiet rather than say no.

workzap_build.text: every quote recorded and followed up on time, with conversion visible.

problems.free_stops: How quotes are tracked and followed up is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Mark this week's pending quotes against actual orders received, so you see which hardware enquiries stall after pricing.
Give one staff member the job of noting every quote outcome in one notebook, so lost follow ups stop slipping away.

problems.words: Corporate clients 90 din baad dete hain
quick_ideas: List every unpaid invoice by age once, so you see who is really holding your cash
Chase the oldest first, because they are the hardest to recover later.

workzap_build.text: corporate receivables with ageing, cheque tracking and reminders.

problems.free_stops: How ageing and reminders are set is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many corporate invoices are waiting past the agreed month, so you see which billing promises are hurting cash flow most.
Keep all unpaid corporate invoice notes with one staff member at one fixed review time, so follow up stays regular with accounts teams.

problems.words: Repair jobs jama ho jaate hain, customers call karte rehte hain
quick_ideas: List all open jobs with their status once, so the stuck ones stand out
Update customers on the oldest jobs, so they hear from you before they call.

workzap_build.text: a repair board with WhatsApp status updates.

problems.ask_first: How many jobs are open now?
problems.free_stops: The job stages and updates are in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count all open repair jobs waiting on parts, testing or pickup, so you see where customer update calls are coming from.
Give one counter person the open repair list and one evening handover, so every caller gets the latest status quickly.

quick_ideas: List every unit out for RMA with its date, so you see how long customers have waited
Chase the oldest with the distributor, so the worst delays move first.

workzap_build.text: an RMA tracker per distributor with days pending.

problems.free_stops: How RMAs are tracked is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Note each RMA case with the item type and send week, so you spot which hardware lines are causing the longest customer waits.
Assign one person to keep the whole RMA notebook and the supplier handover, so customers get clearer updates when claims drag on.

problems.words: Field technician ka pata nahi kahan hai, kya kiya
quick_ideas: Ask technicians to send a photo after each visit, so you see what was done
Keep a job sheet per visit, so extra work can be billed.

workzap_build.text: a job app with tasks, photos, client sign-off and time spent, linked to AMC or billable work.

problems.free_stops: The job app steps and linking are in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Note each field visit's site, arrival and work done in one daily page, so missed visits and unclear effort stand out.
Give one coordinator the job of collecting every technician update before closing, so dispatch and billing stay aligned.

problems.words: Toner orders repeat hain lekin hum yaad nahi dilaate
quick_ideas: List your repeat office clients and their last order once, so you see who is due
Call those due this week, so the next order comes to you first.

workzap_build.text: reorder reminders based on each client's usual cycle.

problems.free_stops: How cycles are worked out is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Check last order dates for regular toner buyers against their usual buying pattern, so overdue repeat business is easy to spot.
Give one staff member the repeat order reminder list and one fixed calling hour, so regular office demand returns to you sooner.

problems.words: Serial note nahi karte, return pe pata nahi hamara unit hai
quick_ideas: Note serials on every invoice from today, so a returned unit can be checked
Record the serials of current stock once, so you start with a clean list.

workzap_build.text: a serial register with cost, supplier, warranty and sale.

problems.free_stops: How serials are captured is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Check returned units against any box labels, warranty slips or invoice notes already available, so disputed returns are easier to challenge.
Give one counter person the job of writing every serial in one notebook at sale time, so returns can be matched fast.

problems.words: Stock Excel mein, rates WhatsApp groups mein
quick_ideas: Put your top items' stock and rate in one sheet once, so you see what you hold and what it's worth
Update it daily for a week, so you see how fast value moves.

workzap_build.text: daily rate lists pulled in, stock and price in one view, with alerts on stock losing value.

problems.ask_first: How many distributors send rate lists?
problems.free_stops: How rates are pulled in is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Walk through the shop and note which fast moving items have stock written in one place but rates found somewhere else, so quoting delays show.
Give one person one master notebook for current stock and buying rates, so the counter stops hunting across different places.

sample_reply.person: Corporate clients ko quote dete hain, do hafte baad confirm karte hain aur tab tak GPU ka rate barh jaata hai. Koi solution?
sample_reply.pi: Ji haan, iska hal hai aur aaj se shuru ho sakta hai. 1) Har quote pe validity date likh dein, taa ke purana rate khud khatam ho. 2) Pichle mahine ke quotes dekh lein kaun se order bane, taa ke pata chale kitna kaam ruka hua hai. Workzap ye aap ke liye khud-ba-khud kar sakta hai: quotation builder jis mein validity date ho, rate badalne pe alert aaye, aur har quote ka order banne tak hisaab rahe. Kya main aap ke liye solution document aur quote banwa doon? Mana bhi kar sakte hain.
